```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Calculate adjusted prices
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors.cumprod()
    
    # Initialize weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)
    
    # Define the window sizes
    short_window = 5
    long_window = 20
    
    # Iterate over each column (asset)
    for col in prices.columns:
        # Calculate rolling means
        short_mean = adjusted_prices[col].rolling(window=short_window).mean().shift(1)
        long_mean = adjusted_prices[col].rolling(window=long_window).mean().shift(1)
        
        # Compute the crossover signal
        crossover_signal = (short_mean - long_mean).apply(np.sign) / 4
        
        # Ensure no non-finite values in the weights
        crossover_signal = crossover_signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf, np.nan], 0)
        
        # Assign the signal to the weights DataFrame
        weights[col] = crossover_signal
    
    return weights
```
